rows.en: (How can I get faster...?)
Guess I'll try one more run...
Yeees~!
(Yamashiro-sensei's hot-blooded too, huh...)

R-really...?
I did just as you advised, though...
(So training takes theory too, huh...)

(Maybe I'll go for a little run today too,
for a change of pace.)

(Oh right, I've gotta stick to
Yamashiro-sensei's advice.)

\p.
You were running again today?
Yes! I was running just like you advised.

"Hmm"...? But you're the one
who taught me!

Your movements were so bizarre,
I couldn't tell.

As I said before, repetition is
the only way. Keep at it, and you'll
get it down eventually.

There's no point pushing yourself
too hard. Take breaks as needed.
("Bizarre"?! How rude, seriously!)
Is that so?
rows.notes: Shared: Yamashiro (frd_itk_002 female) and Kagura (frd_kgr_107). Neutral.

rows.en:
"Is that so"? But you're the one
who taught me!
Okaaay, I'll do my best!
("Bizarre"?! How rude!)
(Eating on the roof feels great~)

(Maybe I should've invited someone...
Oh well, eating alone isn't bad either!)
Hm? Who's that?

\p.
What's this, eating alone?
Oh, yes.
rows.notes: Shared: the player answering Yamashiro here and Sheryl ('wait a moment') in nml_she_016.

rows.en: Honestly, you're a lonely one.
I-I'm not lonely at all!
Hm. Then I suppose I'll eat here too.
W-with you, Sensei?!
What, you don't want to?
No, it's not that...

Then it's settled. Eating with company
aids digestion and nutrient absorption
better than eating alone. Remember that.
Oh, really?
rows.notes: Shared: the player (Yamashiro, Klan, Claire scenes) and Shirakawa (nml_myk_004). Neutral.

rows.en:
Your lunch is bread from the cafeteria?
That's not a balanced diet.
Eat this.
(It's a rolled omelet...)
What's wrong? Don't be shy.
...Where did this omelet come from?

Don't worry, there are no food additives
in it. It's genuinely homemade.
You made it, Sensei?
I did. Why?
Wow~ So you cook, Sensei.
Everyone can cook, surely.

Well, I can't.
Anyway, thanks for the food!

(S-so good... The way the egg's cooked
and the sweetness match perfectly.)
Chew your food well.
Mmf~ 'kaaay.
Here, have some tea.
Thank you for everything.

Now, think nothing of it.
Looking after students' diets
is part of a teacher's job too.

I feel like that's more of
a parent's job...

At school, teachers are as good as
parents, are they not?

Well then, work hard in your afternoon
classes too, and don't doze off.

(All right~ I feel like I can really work
hard in my afternoon classes now.)

(Maybe I should've invited someone...
Oh well, eating alone is nice too!)

Hm? What's with that tiny amount of food?
That won't get you through
your afternoon classes.

Lots of people can't...
Anyway, thanks for the food!

(Y-yummy... The way the egg's cooked
and the sweetness match perfectly.)
Oh, okaaay!

(Okay, I think I might be able to work
hard in my afternoon classes now!)

(Lunch on the roof is the best!
The weather's nice, and so is the view!)

What's this, \p?
Eating lunch alone again...?

Hehehe...
Sensei, want to have lunch with me?

After all, eating with company
improves nutrient absorption.
So you remembered.

Well then, work hard in your
afternoon classes too.
Your answers are first-rate, at least.

(All right, time to work hard
this afternoon too.)

Ehehe...
Sensei, want to have lunch with me?

uncertain: c06184: three Japanese lines with 'oboete oku to ii' at the end; kept in three English lines by moving 'than eating alone' after the verb.
c06190 '...kono tamagoyaki wa?' read as asking where the omelet came from (Yamashiro answers that it is additive-free and homemade).
c06219 'henji dake wa ichininmae da na' (only your reply is full-fledged) rendered 'Your answers are first-rate, at least.'
c06208 is the female variant of c06186 (no cafeteria bread; she has too little food): 'tiny amount' reads the teasing tone.
c06177 'Oh, yes.' and c06185 'Oh, really?' are shared with other scenes and speakers (Sheryl, Klan, Claire, Shirakawa); kept neutral.
